summary: 48 units (97-144): 24 with fixes, 30 issues (3 error, 27 minor). Draft is cautious and honest about obscurity (21 low, 24 medium, 3 high; no unit in 'uncertain'). Main problems: unsupported additions (104 'nor otherwise', 109 'their', 101 'his', 129/102 Hindi, 119 'steer'), a case label contradicted by the translation (110 atithim), glossary renderings (107, 140, 143), imported Rigvedic parallels in notes (116, 120), and a false note (133). No unit needs regrouping. Manual: 101 āśāsata number, 102 matiḥ, 104 ca na/caná, 110 atithim, 113 dūḍhyam, 125 udghed flag.
